observations: Two photos show a rectangular solar panel with a grid of dark, octagonal photovoltaic cells arranged in a honeycomb pattern.
The panel has a white frame and is standing upright, leaning against another similar panel.
The surface of the cells appears dark and reflective, with some minor smudges or dust visible.
No brand name, model number, or specifications are visible on the panel in either photo.
The watermark 'DON KACHI SOLAR ENERGY' is overlaid on both photos.
The background shows a concrete floor and other panels, suggesting a storage or workshop environment.

claims.evidence: Price is not shown in photos; affordability cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially defective or lower efficiency

risks.risk: Panel may not be functional or may have been previously used.
